title: Megurine Luka — Making Lanterns Looks Fun!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, are you home?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Whoa, you scared me...
Please be more gentle with the door when you open it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha. I'm sorry!
But there's something I need to ask you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes! Do you happen to have any spare milk cartons lying around...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I just went over to see how Kohane and the others were doing, and I got to watch them make lanterns for the show...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And now, I feel like making my own!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
They're making lanterns for the show...?
This is an interesting turn of events.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, doesn't it sound fun?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, do you have any milk cartons I can use...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, once I've used up all the milk, I suppose...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I just opened a brand-new one, so it's still very full.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Nooo!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But no one besides you has milk cartons on hand...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, I know! What if we made a bunch of things that require a lot of milk?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
A nice idea if I do say so myself♪
So, let's do our best to get rid of that milk!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There you go again...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I suppose it's worth a try...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see... Which menu item would be best...? What about something like milk pudding?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'd definitely go through the whole carton if we made enough for ten, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, however... That recipe also requires gelatin.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I actually ran out a little earlier while making Christmas desserts.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, what else can we make...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I know! Cream stew!
What if we made that?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I made a batch yesterday because we're having that party, remember? You were there with me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
N-No, you're right...!
I forgot that I even got to taste it...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... What else requires a hefty amount of milk...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, welcome back.
Are you and Rin done practicing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Actually, we're just taking a quick break.
I came to have some cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Cafe au lait...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, would you like lots of extra milk?! You can have as much as you want right now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I'd rather not ruin the coffee by putting in too much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
Can plants absorb milk?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I mean, milk is so nutritious...
What if we tried feeding them some?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It can apparently be used as a sort of fertilizer, but that involves watering it down quite a lot. So, we probably won't end up using all that much...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sob*
At this rate, I'm never going to get to make my lantern...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here's your milk carton.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, how did you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I poured the milk into a glass bottle since it didn't seem like we'd be able to use it all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Y-You're a genius...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you, MEIKO!
Now I can make my lantern!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
My lantern's going to look so beautiful!
Just wait! You'll be the first one who gets to see it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. How should I design it?
